info.name: PLN EMI Backend API
info.description:
All endpoints of backend-emi-compro. See docs/api.md for full rules.

Auth uses the `pln_emi.sid` session cookie: run **Auth > Login** first; Postman keeps the cookie. Other write requests (POST/PUT/DELETE) must send an `Origin` matching the server's `FRONTEND_ORIGIN`; the collection pre-request script adds it from the `frontendOrigin` variable. Public POST /inboxes accepts any Origin, uses no session credentials, and is limited to five attempts per IP every 15 minutes.
